quarterly_data.signal: Capital expenditure in the H1 2026 results: capital expenditure on property, plant and equipment and software-related intangible assets was $1,513m in H1 2026 (H1 2025: $1,303m), the increase driven by investment in several major manufacturing projects and continued investment in technology upgrades. In FY 2025 it was $3,270m, and the Group expects to increase this expenditure in FY 2026 by approximately a third, driven by manufacturing expansion projects and investments in systems and technology.
quarterly_data.figure: H1 2026 capex $1,513m (H1 2025: $1,303m); FY 2025 $3,270m; FY 2026 expected up approximately a third

quarterly_data.signal: Partner and alliance revenue detail in the H1 2026 results: US in-market sales of Enhertu, recorded by Daiichi Sankyo, were $1,440m in H1 2026 (H1 2025: $1,128m), and from Q4 2025 AstraZeneca's mid-single-digit percentage royalty on Daiichi Sankyo's Enhertu sales in Japan is recorded in Established RoW. H1 2026 Alliance Revenue: Enhertu $1,058m (H1 2025: $834m), Tezspire $372m ($285m), Beyfortus $123m ($109m) and Datroway $93m ($14m). Other Oncology includes $14m of Total Revenue from Orpathys, partnered with HUTCHMED. Beyfortus Total Revenue (Product Sales of manufactured product to Sanofi plus Alliance Revenue) was $194m in H1 2026, down 18%, which the company attributes to the partner's adjustment of inventory levels.
quarterly_data.figure: Enhertu US in-market sales $1,440m (H1 2025: $1,128m); Alliance Revenue Enhertu $1,058m, Tezspire $372m, Beyfortus $123m, Datroway $93m; Beyfortus $194m (-18%)

quarterly_data.signal: Further legal developments disclosed with the H1 2026 results: in April 2026 AstraZeneca settled all US Lynparza patent litigation with Sandoz (ANDA cases against Natco, Cipla and Zydus continue with no trial date); in May 2026 the Delaware State Court awarded AstraZeneca $11.1m for the Syntimmune sellers' breach of a merger-agreement representation on manufacturing of drug substance and product supply, while AstraZeneca intends to appeal the earlier adverse decisions ($130m first milestone found achieved and $181m in damages); in May 2026 the US Supreme Court denied review of AstraZeneca's Inflation Reduction Act challenge, concluding that matter; in July 2026 AstraZeneca and GSK agreed to settle the niraparib royalty dispute; in July 2026 AstraZeneca filed a patent infringement claim in Russia against OncoTarget LLC over a generic Tagrisso; and the US Farxiga / Xigduo XR product liability cases have an agreement in principle to resolve for an immaterial amount.
quarterly_data.figure: Syntimmune: $11.1m awarded to AstraZeneca; adverse $130m and $181m decisions to be appealed
